title: Main Scenario: A Realm Reborn
description: A coast of old stone under a blue night; the lesser moon broken into falling embers, a crystal spire on the far shore.

title: Main Scenario: Heavensward
description: Gothic spires of a holy city above snow, a great winged shape crossing the moon, falling snow.

title: Main Scenario: Stormblood
description: A crimson night over a lakeside fortress and a far eastern tower across the water; a war banner lifts in the wind.

title: Main Scenario: Shadowbringers
description: Night returning to a sky drowned in light: violet dark breaking through a white glare, a crystal tower rising over a lake.

title: Main Scenario: Endwalker
description: A blue world's limb rising beyond the moon, a colonnade of learning on the shore, a pale gold dawn at the edge of night.

title: Main Scenario: Dawntrail
description: A stepped golden pyramid above a green lowland, its stair a road of light, the sky warm at the horizon.

title: Sidequests: La Noscea
description: Sea cliffs and a sailing ship at anchor under a teal night; the harbour lamps low on the water.

title: Sidequests: The Black Shroud
description: A deep forest of giant trees at the water's edge, fireflies drifting over a still pool.

title: Sidequests: Thanalan
description: Warm desert night: mesas and dunes, a domed city of merchants glowing gold on the far shore.

title: Sidequests: Coerthas and Ishgard
description: Snowbound highlands under a pale moon: a lone watchtower on a white ridge, snow on the wind.

title: Sidequests: Dravania and Abalathia
description: Islands adrift in a sea of cloud, rookery spires of rock, a long-winged shape far off.

title: Sidequests: Gyr Abania and Othard
description: Tall karst peaks over a rose-dusk sea, a gate standing in the shallows, lanterns on a far pier.

title: Sidequests: Norvrandt
description: Lakeland shallows under a violet night: trees of crystal, fae lights and petals on the water.

title: Sidequests: Ilsabard, Sharlayan and Thavnair
description: A port city of onion domes and a scholar's tower across a still harbour, a cold northern ridge behind.

title: Sidequests: Tural
description: Jungle highlands and a falling cascade under a warm teal night, palms leaning over the river mouth.

title: Allied Societies
description: A night gathering by the water: tents and hide pennants round a fire, its sparks rising toward the moon.

title: Class and Job Quests
description: A training ground on a knoll by the water: a sword and a staff crossed and planted, a hammer and a fishing rod beside them.

title: Grand Company
description: A watchtower and rampart above a harbour, three company standards in storm red, serpent gold and flame black.

title: Seasonal Events
description: A festival night: paper lanterns drifting on the water, fireworks opening over the far shore under a crescent.

title: Chronicles of a New Era
description: A colossal ancient guardian half sunk in the sea, a ring of ruined arches beside it, the old tales written in the stars.

title: Hildibrand Adventures
description: A gentleman inspector's evening: a gas lamp on the quay, a top hat left on a bollard, a magnifier catching the crescent.

title: Relic Weapons and Unusual Endeavours
description: An anvil on a stone shelf by the water, a blade standing in it and glowing, sparks climbing toward the moon.

title: Other Quests
description: The moon road itself: calm water, a low far shore and a wide sky of stars.
